name: idle
prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Animation sheet for EXACT reference LUNGER skeletal gravehound: quadruped dog skeleton, long canine skull, exposed ivory ribs/spine, rusty red torn hide, long thin bone tail. RIGHT facing sideview all frames, no redesign. 4 columns x5 rows =20 distinct isolated poses. Uniform anatomical scale, root fixed relative to cell, feet baseline common, upper-left lighting pixel art same as reference. TRUE transparent background no halo/shadow/text/particles/dust. Row1: idle A, subtle idle B, walk right foreleg forward contact, walk passing. Row2: walk left contact, walk opposite passing, windup crouch slight, windup lower crouch coiling rearlegs. Row3: final compressed spring crouch, active gallop extended horizontal, active gallop legs tucked, active gallop alternate extended landing. Row4: recovery braking exhausted low head, recovery low exhausted HOLD (not ready), hurt short recoil, hurt settles. Row5: death stumbling forelegs collapse, death knees down, death rolling side, death fully horizontal collapsed corpse. Anatomical lengths and skull size must stay same despite crouching or falling. No humanoid poses. Each cell generous empty gutter, complete silhouette and tail contained. Crisp distinct leg positions for walk and gallop.
